final_assessment: Session boundary for the tripwires exploration: tripwires are sensors behind one contract (D-tw-1), each firing on an undeclared deviation from a reference fixed before the run (D-tw-3), recorded as readings on the seam emits and shown nowhere at the defaults, with a tripwire stop written only under a per-sensor halt setting (D-tw-5, D-tw-6). The built-in sensors are settled: Touchpoints past a tolerance (D-tw-17, superseding D-tw-4 on a measurement of 14 changes), review circling (D-tw-7), undeclared capability (D-tw-15), ruling or goal edits (D-tw-16), byte budgets (D-tw-13); the steward is a new single-question independent review at each cited change's archive, off by default (D-tw-8 to D-tw-10); project sensors run only after per-machine approval of the exact set, the user's answer to a security-unprecedented stop (D-tw-11, D-tw-12); late declarations count only as the user's answer (D-tw-14). Skill-size reduction is its own architect work (D-tw-2). Carried: the stage charter's steward parenthetical is reworded at the next architect session; the stage likely divides into three changes at propose.

residuals.kind: a sensor needing state that is neither committed, on the trail, nor producible by a command (a live session's transcript, its token spend)
residuals.method: classifying each drift that G6's first-run closing review finds no sensor caught against these four kinds

residuals.kind: a sensor whose reference cannot be read at its fixed point (no `## Touchpoints` section, a project sensor with no reading at propose, a baseline file missing)
residuals.method: each sensor states how it reads its reference; a sensor that cannot read it returns a reading saying so, which is recorded like a firing — silence is never a pass

residuals.kind: a loop circling on one problem that the key cannot see — a finding re-titled between passes; a walk record unreadable to the gate, which owes no verdict; fixes repeated without an in-context verification between them
residuals.method: first-run's closing review reading each change's walks for one file fixed in two or more walks of one gate

residuals.kind: what a sensor's command reads beyond its declaration and the files its argv names — a script those call, the tool's own configuration (a linter's rule file)
residuals.method: the Touchpoints sensor fires on an edit to such a file the plan did not predict only past its tolerances (D-tw-17), so a small edit passes; first-run's closing review reads each change's edits to files its sensors read
